# Become Albino

**Version 1.2** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2232333172) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=become-albino&expanded=true)

Turn anyone in the world albino, and decide how far it goes.

At its simplest this is a cosmetic mod: a trait that washes the colour out of a
character's skin, hair and eyes and lightens their brows. No stats, no bonuses,
nothing but the look.

But you can also found a bloodline that passes the look down the generations, or
skip the pretence entirely and grant the base game's own albino trait, which
carries real weight. Three options, one menu, all reversible.

---

## Three ways to be albino

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Make Albino** | The look, on one character. Stops with them. |
| **Found an Albino Bloodline** | The same look, inherited by every child born afterwards, and by theirs in turn. |
| **Grant True Albinism** | The base game's own albino trait, with all of its actual effects. |

There is also **Make Their Children Albino**, which brings a character's
existing children into the bloodline — founding one only affects children born
afterwards.

## How to use it

Right-click any character, yourself included, and the options are under friendly
interactions. **Remove Albino** clears whichever one they are carrying.

## On True Albinism

The base game added a real albino trait some years after this mod was written.
Granting it is a gameplay decision rather than a cosmetic one: the character
becomes more dreadful, other albinos warm to them, most other people cool
slightly, and because it is genetic the game handles passing it down in its own
way. Reach for it when you want albinism to mean something mechanically.

## What actually changes

- **Skin** shifted to the palest end of its range
- **Hair** shifted to white
- **Eyes** shifted toward red
- **Eyebrows** thinned and lightened to match

The change works on the character's own genes rather than replacing them, so
the result still looks like *that* person. Facial structure, age and
everything else are untouched. It also applies to any character in the game,
not just your own dynasty.

## Things to know

- **The two mod traits are purely cosmetic.** No modifiers, no opinion
  effects. Only True Albinism touches gameplay.
- **Fully reversible**, at any time, with no cooldown.
- **One at a time.** The three are mutually exclusive.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against **CK3 1.19 "Scribe"**.
- **Ironman and achievements:** this mod will disable achievements, as
  gameplay mods do.
- **Other mods:** it adds two traits and five interactions, and
  overwrites no base game file. It should sit alongside almost anything,
  including other portrait mods, though two mods both rewriting the same genes
  may fight over the result.
- **Existing saves:** safe to add mid-game. If you remove the mod, affected
  characters simply revert to their normal appearance.

## Languages

Available in all nine languages the game supports. English is fully written;
the other eight currently show the English wording. Translations are welcome
and are only a few short lines.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `become-albino-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=become-albino&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
